description.default: Seamlessly integrate local files into SiYuan. Browse/search/manage disk files, insert links with one click, support audio/video timestamps & subtitle-to-timestamp, auto-sync links when files move, relative paths for cross-device sync. Pure local, zero cloud dependency.
description.zh_CN: 把本地文件系统无缝融入思源笔记。浏览/搜索/管理磁盘文件、一键插入笔记、支持音视频时间戳、字幕转换时间戳，文件移动后自动同步替换新链接，相对路径支持跨设备同步。纯本地运行，跨设备零依赖。
